intro: Torn Murloc Fins serve as proof of work for the Stormwind Army's standing bounty on hostile amphibians in eastern Elwynn Forest. Harvested from foragers and lurkers along the riverbanks, they demonstrate that local waterways are being systematically cleared.

p: As the murloc population along eastern Elwynn's streams and lakes surged, the Stormwind Army authorized a direct bounty to cull their numbers. Guard Thomas, stationed at the bridge spanning the eastern river, collects these severed fins to verify kills. With Stormwind's military stretched thin defending against internal unrest and regional threats, local authorities rely heavily on traveling adventurers to bring in physical proof of cleared encampments.
